g.title: HHT_QSP
g.text: Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia · Osler-Weber-Rendu · QSP map
ALK1/ENG/SMAD4 are regulators of the endothelial
, so inward remodelling becomes outward remodelling
Shear stress does not rise monotonically with lumen size (the feeder vessel limit) — which is why nasal lesions can be reversed with drugs and hepatic · pulmonary AVMs cannot
Anaemia is not only an outcome but an
: Hb↓ → cardiac output↑ → shear stress↑ → lesion enlargement → bleeding↑
Clinical benefit is not continuous but a
: whether the iron absorption ceiling (17.8 mL/day on oral iron) is exceeded is what decides transfusion dependence

g.title: cluster_mech
g.text: 4. Shear stress mechanotransduction — the normal set point circuit

g.title: cluster_vegf
g.text: 6. VEGF-A · VEGFR2 · PI3K/AKT — the angiogenic drive
the drive that bevacizumab and pazopanib remove

g.title: cluster_mural
g.text: 7. Mural cell coverage — the determinant of bleeding fragility
PDGF-B / PDGFRβ · the target of the thalidomide class (PMID 20364125)

g.title: cluster_av
g.text: 8. Arteriovenous identity · loss of the capillary bed

g.title: cluster_lesion
g.text: 9. Lesion population dynamics — number N, mean lumen S
severity tracks lesion NUMBER; calibre has a stable fixed point

g.title: cluster_gi
g.text: 25-30% of patients; the reason some become transfusion-dependent

g.title: cluster_hemo
g.text: 12. Haemostasis · fibrinolysis — the one point tranexamic acid touches
TXA moves duration, not episode count (PMID 25040799)

g.title: cluster_liver
g.text: 13. Hepatic vascular malformation — the high-output heart failure route

g.title: cluster_pavm
g.text: 14. Pulmonary · cerebral AVM — embolism and haemorrhage
PAVM ~50% of HHT1; embolisation, never drugs

g.title: cluster_iron
g.text: 15. ★ Iron flux balance — the origin of the clinical threshold

g.title: cluster_ery
g.text: production is iron-FLUX limited, not store limited

g.title: cluster_cardiac
g.text: 17. ★ Cardiac output · high-output heart failure — where the feedback closes
Hb ↓ → CO ↑ → WSS ↑ → lesion ↑ → bleeding ↑ → Hb ↓

g.title: cluster_bev
g.text: 18. Bevacizumab — why systemic works and nasal does not

g.title: cluster_paz
g.text: VEGFR2 benefit vs PDGFRβ penalty → why 50-150 mg, not 800 mg

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: what each can and cannot reach

g.title: HAPLO
g.text: the whole systemic endothelium is sensitised

g.title: SOMHIT
g.text: biallelic loss in a local clone

g.title: BMP10
g.text: from the right atrium · equipotent at ALK1

g.title: SETPOINT
g.text: normal: WSS↑ → inward remodelling → WSS returns

g.title: VEGFR1
g.text: decoy receptor · expression reduced in HHT

g.title: QUIESC
g.text: low proliferation · low migration · tight junctions kept

g.title: FEEDER
g.text: shear stress does not rise monotonically

g.title: BASIN_A
g.text: conducting artery supply → shear never saturates

g.title: CAPLOSS
g.text: Loss of the interposed capillary bed
= the anatomical definition of a shunt

g.title: PERICYTE
g.text: mechanical support of the vessel wall

g.title: INVOL
g.text: accelerates once the drive is removed

g.title: AGEACC
g.text: → plateau in the fifties and sixties

g.title: TPA
g.text: high local activity in the mucosa

g.title: IRONINDEP
g.text: = the endpoint a continuous score cannot show

g.title: RECYC
g.text: Iron recycled from senescent red cells

g.title: FATIGUE
g.text: the main determinant of quality of life

g.title: PERFP->WSS
g.text: ★ the edge that closes the loop

g.title: HOCF
g.text: no cure other than liver transplantation

g.title: BEVC
g.text: CL 0.207 L/day · V1 2.9 L · t½ ~20 days

g.title: BEVBIND
g.text: KD ≈ 1.1 nM · works by molar excess

g.title: BEVFAIL
g.text: ★ The failure of the nasal route, quantified
not too small a dose but the wrong route

g.title: PAZNET
g.text: at high dose the loss of mural cell coverage
erodes the gain from blocking angiogenesis

g.title: POMDOSE
g.text: the basis of the PATH-HHT approval

g.title: POMMECH
g.text: it does not shrink the lumen but
matures the vessel and so lowers fragility

g.title: EMBOL
g.text: Coil embolisation of a pulmonary AVM
★ the only means that removes the flow itself

g.title: LTX
g.text: the definitive treatment for high-output heart failure

g.title: CURACAO
g.text: epistaxis · telangiectasia · visceral lesions · family history
